flow.name: axn-term-hmr - session IPC works on the vite origin
flow.description: Launch axn-term-hmr against a temp state dir with this repo as the dev checkout, wait for the spawned vite server, and verify the frontend on http://localhost:5914 can create a session and write to its PTY — i.e. the whole IPC surface passes the ACL on the vite origin.

step.description: Temp state dir + dev-hmr.json pointing at this checkout
Launch axn-term-hmr; a session appearing proves the vite origin passes the IPC ACL
vite responds and a PTY write round-trips
